main_body: Snow-covered conifer: a stacked cone of dark green foliage tiers, each topped by a white snow band, on a short brown trunk
top_band: Mid-column, white/pale blue snow bands about 5 rows tall (e.g. rows 35-39 and 47-51), then green foliage below. The tip is a white snow cap at rows 1-5.
evidence: Down the centre column each tier shows a lighter snow band, a scalloped drip edge with dark notches under it, then a darker green face. The snow bands are thick enough to read as upward-facing surfaces rather than 1-2px rims, and no receding side faces are drawn. The cone is symmetric and the snow bands are slightly diagonal, so the 3/4 read is moderate but acceptable for an organic tree.

style.evidence: The references are rounded leafy canopies with 5-6 greens, clumped leaf texture and tinted outlines. The candidate has about 3-4 greens plus 3 snow tones. The left tier faces have a few speckle dots, but the right half of each tier is a large near-flat dark green area of 5x5 pixels or more. The outline is a dark navy that is nearly neutral in places. The cone is clean but simpler and flatter than the reference trees.
